calls.menu.forceTcpFooter: Turn it on only if calls don’t connect on your network: TCP adds latency.
calls.menu.recordInfo: Video calls: the other side’s video with your camera in the corner, 720p
calls.menu.recordingFooter: Recordings stay on this device only, in the account’s folder. Nothing goes to the cloud until you send a recording from the list yourself. While recording, the call screen shows a recording mark. Recording a conversation without the other side’s consent is illegal in some countries.
calls.menu.recordingsInfo: Listen, share, send to Saved Messages
calls.menu.screenFooter: The stats panel can be dragged — its place is remembered. It updates only while the call screen is open.
calls.menu.silentMuteFooter: A normal mute sends the other side a “microphone off” mark. A silent mute just stops sending sound: on their screen your microphone stays on and they hear silence. Private calls only — in group calls the microphone state lives on the server.
calls.menu.silentMuteInfo: The other side doesn’t see that you muted
calls.menu.soundboardDuckInfo: Your voice is 4× quieter while a sound plays
calls.menu.soundboardFooter: The sound is mixed into what you send and goes through the same codec as your voice. The sound button appears on the call screen, in group calls too.
calls.menu.soundsInfo: Your sounds from Files or from videos
calls.menu.statsOverlayInfo: Duration, signal quality, throughput and network
calls.recordings.footer: Audio is AAC at 64 kbit/s (about 0.5 MB a minute), video is 720p at up to 24 fps (about 12 MB a minute). Deleting a recording deletes its file.
calls.recordings.title: Call recordings
calls.sounds.footer: Only the sound is taken from a video. Sounds longer than a minute are cut. The files stay on this device.
calls.sounds.title: Sound library
